description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Your depraved mind has become a maelstrom of corruption and insanity that affects everyone around you. Sentient beings within your Willpower yards from you must succeed with an Average (+20) Cool Test every round or get swept away by your contagious derangement. Consult the @Table[contagious-madness] Table to see how they spend their round. If they're already affected by the madness they don't have to make a Test that round. As you are yourself also quite mad you gain -10 Intelligence. You can only gain this mutation once.
